name: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City & Logan, UT) Gluten-Free Crust Plain Cheese Pizza
brandOrRestaurant: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Summit Pizza offers a dedicated gluten-free crust that is thin, crispy, and free of wheat fructans. Excellent for gluten-sensitive IBD diners at Bear Lake.
